meanings.note: Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'agitation, restlessness'.

examples.text: Désolé pour mon agitation tout à l'heure.
Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Appelle Clémentine. Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: Call Clémentine. Tell her I can't come tonight.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = can I call you?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

examples.text: C'est comme un rêve pour moi.

meanings.note: Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 'con-'/'com-' (from Latin 'cum') means 'with, together'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'concession, compromise'.

examples.text: J'ai toujours refusé de faire des concessions.

meanings.en: to know a person or place
ne rien connaître à = to know nothing about

French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Tu es une femme libre et rebelle.
examples.trans: You are a free and rebellious woman.

examples.text: Cécile de France? Refusée, à cause de son âge.
examples.trans: Cécile de France? Turned down, because of her age.

meanings.note: être refusé(e) = to be turned down
être refusé(e) = to be turned down

examples.text: On peut retourner sur le plateau?

meanings.en: to go back, to return (conjugated with être)
meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to return, to go back'.

meanings.en: to drive, travel by vehicle; to roll

examples.text: J'ai sauvé une cliente de l'agence, c'est tout.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to save, rescue'.
